messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
may 8 Notes:


Today I did not take any trades and I was watching charts during london as well as the later bit of nyam. Today was up the whole tome and I was looking for retracement into pd arrays to long, but we never got anything that I was looking for  and as I go through the charts there are no trades that I can confidently take. 9:30 opened above all time highs and we ripped up all the way until 10:00 where we. got a little manipulation lower and consolidation before trading higher for the rest of the day. (Screenshot 1)
,
This week was a really strong week for nq where we saw 1400 points to the upside so going into next week I may expect a retracement, but until we actually see any signs of it I will be bullish for every session. That is the best way to trade all time highs. As per this week I took two good trades that I am happy with. Both breakeven, but both went to tp afterwards. As long as I continue to trade strongly and don’t get discouraged by a few losses, I will have a good month, pass this account, and then get a payout.
,
